name: Penguin Math Race
tagline: Solve the sum, hop the ice, beat three rival penguins to the flag.
description:
Penguin Math Race turns arithmetic into a race on the ice. Tap the right answer to hop forward, build combos with fast, accurate answers and reach the finish line before three rival penguins.

Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division come in three difficulty ranges. Daily quests, a seven-day reward streak and 34 collectable costumes, each with its own levels and effects, keep every race a little different. You can also race the ghost of your own best run.
coverAlt: Penguins in costumes, a king, a dinosaur, a ballerina, a vampire, an astronaut and a pirate, standing on blocks of ice.
